item.title: Boys’ hoop edged in fieldhouse opener
item.description: By Ken Chaisson The Walpole Timberwolves boys’ basketball team renewed acquaintances with the Norwood Mustangs in the sparkling new fieldhouse on Thursday, January 22, 2026. It was the second game of a rare doubleheader along with the girls’ team to celebrate the opening of the new facility. The old gym could fit 460 people. The new fieldhouse can sit 1,200.
